core_failure_questions.question: Did the counterfactual candidate intervention produce sufficiently variable and directionally useful delta_u targets?
Was the candidate intervention itself beneficial often enough to support learnable utility supervision?
Did the utility target transformation compress most targets near 0.5?
Did the utility selector receive and express meaningful optimization signal?
Did learned utility discriminate corruption severity, modality failure, mismatch state, or realized intervention benefit?
Was the failure primarily caused by the candidate action space, utility-target construction, selector optimization, or evidence representation?

primary_observed_failure: clean, graded, and catastrophic active-intervention rates were all 0.0
utility probabilities remained near the neutral 0.5 initialization
utility selectivity and evidence-utility alignment were not established

prohibited_actions: change v0.31 thresholds or H5 bins
introduce a new intervention architecture before v0.32 characterization is frozen

research_direction.name: Utility-Learning Failure Characterization
research_direction.objective: Determine why the v0.31 utility-learning pathway failed to produce a discriminative intervention signal before designing any successor intervention mechanism.

successor_rule: Any architecture or loss redesign must occur only in a later prospectively frozen version after v0.32 failure characterization is complete.
title: Utility-Learning Failure Characterization Direction
